`requirements.md` has been updated per the Gate 1 revision:

- **IS-3**, **Diagnosis (point 4)**, **FR-3**, **FR-8**, and **AC-3** have been narrowed so that the fix only prevents app root elements from crashing before finalization, while explicitly preserving `RouteResolver`'s (`packages/frontend-app-api/src/routing/RouteResolver.ts:153`) existing throw behavior for callers after the app is finalized.
- All other sections remain unchanged.
